{{Quote|'Asteroid mover?' Is that what they call it? 'World Killer' is more like it! Ah, those Jedi, so lacking in ambition.|Andal Sait|<ref name="DS">{{SWGTCG|set=Champions of the Force|scenario=Dark Side scenario campaign}}</ref>}}
'''Andal Sait''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], he commanded the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Blackguard (Star Destroyer)|''Blackguard'']]. He went rogue and attempted to sell his command to [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] in the [[Bright Jewel system/Legends|Bright Jewel system]], while declaring himself to be a [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]].

==Biography==
He showed interest in obtaining the [[Codex of Tython]], an ancient [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] discovered by the agents of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. Looking to complete the Codex, a Rebel agent smuggled himself aboard the ''Blackguard'', trying to obtain Sait's piece of the holocron. However, the fragment was secretly stolen from Sait by [[Adrick]], an ambitious [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] officer. The Rebel got into a firefight with Adrick and Sait, during which Sait escaped and Adrick was forced to hand over the fragment, before departing the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] in a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]].<ref>{{SWGTCG|set=Champions of the Force|scenario=Light Side scenario campaign}}</ref>

The holocron was reassembled and taken to [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]], however an [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|ISB]] agent managed to recover it from Rebel hands. He contacted Sait, showing him the plans for a massive device that moved asteroids, stored in the holocron. Such device could crush a starship with its power or be used to bombard a planet with asteroids. Sait became interested by such a [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] and asked the agent to deliver the holocron to him, along with the focusing crystal needed for the weapon. This allowed the Imperial engineers to install the superweapon aboard the ''Blackguard''.<ref name="DS" />

Later, Sait organized a ceremony to present various officers and dignitaries his newest acquisition&mdash;a [[CY-M Prototype]] [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]]&mdash;recovered by his troops on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]]. Unknown to all the guests, a group of undercover [[Slicer/Legends|slicers]] aboard the Star Destroyer altered the programming of the [[Droid/Legends|droid]]. The CY-M, armed with a large [[Vibro-ax/Legends|vibro-ax]], jumped into the crowd and started swinging its weapon in a deadly move. However, the droid was soon pushed into a nearby airlock, which was immediately opened into space.<ref name="DS" />

Andal Sait was killed during the [[Retaking of the Blackguard|Retaking of the ''Blackguard'']].<ref name="SWG:SD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Andal Sait was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:SD" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Andal Sait was added to the game as part of the [[W:c:swg:Lost Star Destroyer|"Star Destroyer" Heroic Encounter]],<ref name="SWG:SD" /> introduced with the release of the [[W:c:swg:Chapter 8 Notes for Jan 15 2008|"Chapter 8" update]], on [[January 15]], [[2008]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 8: The Nova Orion Crisis">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67563&month=012008|text=Chapter 8: The Nova Orion Crisis}}</ref>
